subgoals.objective_name: To identify organizational assets and define appropriate protection responsibilities.
subgoals.goal_name: Identify organizational assets and define appropriate protection responsibilities

subgoals.control_name: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up and maintained.

subgoals.goal_name: Identify assets associated with information and information processing facilities and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up
subgoals.embedding_context: Identify assets associated with information and information processing facilities and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up

actions.name: Data Inventory
actions.description: Data inventorying identifies and records the schemas, formats, volumes, and locations of data stored and used on the organization's architecture.

actions.name: Configuration Inventory
actions.description: Configuration inventory identifies and records the configuration of software and hardware and their components throughout the organization.

actions.name: Network Node Inventory
actions.description: Network node inventorying identifies and records all the network nodes (hosts, routers, switches, firewalls, etc.) in the organization's architecture.

actions.name: Hardware Component Inventory
actions.description: Hardware component inventorying identifies and records the hardware items in the organization's architecture.

actions.name: Software Inventory
actions.description: Software inventorying identifies and records the software items in the organization's architecture.

subgoals.goal_name: Maintain assets associated with information and information processing facilities
subgoals.embedding_context: Maintain assets associated with information and information processing facilities

subgoals.control_name: Assets maintained in the inventory shall be owned.

subgoals.goal_name: Ensure assets maintained in the inventory are owned
subgoals.embedding_context: Ensure assets maintained in the inventory are owned

actions.name: Asset Inventory
actions.description: Asset inventorying identifies and records the organization's assets and enriches each inventory item with knowledge about their vulnerabilities.

actions.name: Asset Vulnerability Enumeration
actions.description: Asset vulnerability enumeration enriches inventory items with knowledge identifying their vulnerabilities.

subgoals.control_name: Rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified, documented and implemented.

subgoals.goal_name: Identify rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities
subgoals.embedding_context: Identify rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities

subgoals.goal_name: Document rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities
subgoals.embedding_context: Document rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities

subgoals.goal_name: Implement rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities
subgoals.embedding_context: Implement rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities

subgoals.control_name: All employees and external party users shall return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

subgoals.goal_name: Return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement
subgoals.agent: All employees and external party users
subgoals.embedding_context: Return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement
